name: awards-carousel.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  awards-carousel.scss — MANIFEST for <awards-carousel> (shadow-scoped
//  via ?inline): the home page's awards strip / selected-work carousel —
//  full-bleed slides that peek into adjacent ones on both sides, WebGL
//  arrow controls, and dot/pill navigation. Split by variant into
//  awards-carousel/ partials (imported below):
//    _base       .aw-c container, track, controls, dots, action-appear
//    _selected   selected-work variant (viewport slides + peek)
//    _explore    explore/archive variant (~60% cards + peek)
//    _awards     awards variant (dark footer, 10s timer)
//  Slides fade+rise into view on first paint (aw-c--in-view).
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';

@import 'awards-carousel/base';
@import 'awards-carousel/selected';
@import 'awards-carousel/explore';
@import 'awards-carousel/awards';

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
